html:
Norodom Sihanouk was king of Cambodia, then its prime minister, head of state and again king. He won independence from France in 1953 and shaped the country's fate until the 1990s.

Crowned by the French in 1941, he campaigned for independence and won it without war. He gave up the throne in 1955 to lead politics directly, and tried to keep Cambodia neutral in the Vietnam War.

In 1970 he was overthrown by Lon Nol, which set off the civil war. He then backed the Khmer Rouge, who kept him under house arrest while they ruled. After the UN transition he returned as king in 1993 and gave up the throne again in 2004. He also made films and wrote songs.
sum: Norodom Sihanouk was king of Cambodia, then its prime minister, head of state and again king. He won independence from France in 1953 and shaped the country's fate until the 1990s.
